verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform like Datadog, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the SaaS API, SDKs that send data to Datadog, and an MCP server; nothing shows a self-hostable version of the core platform. The community items are about pricing, UX and sales, which are off-topic and ignored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
